participantElections.effectiveLabel: Item 1 sworn allegation — the petition did not result in a domestic violence or non-temporary interpersonal order
participantElections.reason: item 1 alleges, above your signature, that the petition in this case did not result in the issuance of a domestic violence or non-temporary interpersonal order. Screening tells you whether this route is open to you; your signature tells the court this is true of your case. Check it only if it is.

participantElections.effectiveLabel: Item 2 sworn allegation — six months have elapsed since the case was dismissed
participantElections.reason: item 2 alleges that six months have elapsed since the case was dismissed. Count from the dismissal date on your own case papers and check it only if six months have actually passed.

participantElections.effectiveLabel: Item 3 sworn allegation — the respondent has not been bound by an order of protection in those six months
participantElections.reason: item 3 alleges that during those six months the respondent has not been bound by an order of protection issued for the protection of any person. LegalEase does not hold your protective-order history and does not ask for it, so only you can answer this.

valuesTooLongForTheWidgetTheFormDraws.whatThisIs: a held fact that cannot be printed legibly inside the widget the court drew. It is refused rather than clipped, because a clipped value on a filing is a wrong value and not a shorter one.
